scientific_scope: Prospective P3-v1 painted-trail mechanism freeze after permanent P2-v1 closure. This record defines the exact relative bilateral sensory/transduction structure before implementation, simulation, parameter estimation, response-target semantic access, or Y-maze access. The selected mechanism class is supported mechanistically in Linepithema humile and is not claimed as established Lasius niger physiology.

frozen_relevant_facts: Turning responded to local pheromone concentration while moving speed was largely unaffected.
The reported response followed a Weber-like relative bilateral rule in which left-right pheromone difference divided by their sum determined turning magnitude.
Experimental analysis used front-left and front-right local sectors and reported robustness to tested sector-size changes.
The source does not establish that Lasius niger uses the same exact geometry, gain, field representation, or equation constants.

poissonnier_et_al_2026.frozen_relevant_fact: No tested modulation by prior path distance, travel direction, or recent food experience is used to create any P3 context-specific response parameter.

p2_closure_boundary.rule: P2 target-ranked outcomes may not determine this P3 equation, sector geometry, quadrature, parameter values, bounds, seeds, budgets, folds, weights, objective, or promotion criteria.

mechanism.concept: Each moving ant senses the painted-trail scalar field in deterministic front-left and front-right local sectors. The two nonnegative sector summaries are transformed only through a scale-invariant Weber/Michelson contrast. Steering is toward the side with larger local pheromone summary. P3-v1 contains no transient lapse state and no response RNG.

digital_operator.sector_summary: R = arithmetic mean of C(p_R(i,j)) over 32 samples; L = arithmetic mean of C(p_L(i,j)) over 32 samples
digital_operator.weighting: equal weights; sqrt radial transform makes radial bins equal-area under the polar midpoint approximation
digital_operator.reason_for_freeze: Fixes one deterministic, rotation-covariant digital implementation of local sector sensing before any simulation or target-ranked outcome is observed.

relative_transduction.zero_signal_rule: When both sector summaries are zero, the relative signal is exactly zero rather than introducing an epsilon or threshold parameter.
relative_transduction.positive_scale_invariance: For any finite a>0 in exact arithmetic, W(aL,aR)=W(L,R).

steering.sign_convention: Positive W means the right sector has more pheromone and uses the same positive rightward steering sign convention as the frozen P1/P2 local response code.
steering.kappa_trail_per_s_role: shared steering-gain structural parameter; no biological value or estimation bound is selected by this gate

mechanism.canonical_update_order: When active, apply omega_trail*dt to heading immediately before the unchanged canonical Ant.update step, matching the previously audited painted-trail update ordering.
mechanism.moving_step_rule: Evaluate painted-trail steering only when the ant is not finished, is not already paused, and a preview of the canonical pause hazard indicates the ant will move; preview the hazard by cloning canonical biology RNG state without mutation.

engineering_only_reachability_values.value_rationale: sigma=8 mm and kappa=4 s^-1 reuse pre-target engineering values already frozen before P2 target-ranked outcomes, solely to isolate the new relative bilateral operator during reference-free implementation reachability. Sector radius follows the source-inspired 1 cm local experimental analysis geometry as an engineering structure, not a fitted Lasius niger value.
